mostWorthwhile.text: Making the binding boards was most worthwhile: their named slots showed how the earlier studies would come together.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive fittings became repetitive once the pattern was clear.

surprise.text: Thread and planks made a loom, whose purpose in this chapter remained unclear.

arbitrary.text: Making the loom felt disconnected from the encyclopedia task; its use was never shown.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter if it offered more varied decisions; assembling the book was satisfying, but the repeated fittings became routine.
